findings.detail: The designated tree contains only PROPOSAL.json; it contains no implementation source. Consequently there is no code to verify for train-only covariance estimation, rho=0.1 shrinkage, the eigenvalue floor, fixed centering/transform, unchanged RQ-VAE behavior, or single global hard SID assignment. Fidelity cannot be credited from the idea description alone.
findings.reproduction: Inspect the designated tree with find: its only file is PROPOSAL.json. There is no trainer/model/preprocessing/export code to execute or compare with the specification.
findings.correction: Add the implementation to this tree, including the frozen train-fitted transform and its application at training and assignment; then rerun the independent review against the actual source.

findings.detail: No forward/backward implementation is present, so finite losses, gradient flow to intended model parameters, dead loss terms, and numerical stability cannot be tested. The proposal file is not executable training code.
findings.reproduction: Attempting to locate or invoke a trainer within the designated tree fails because the tree contains only PROPOSAL.json; there is no real forward/backward path to run.
findings.correction: Include the actual model and trainer entry point in the tree and demonstrate a real forward/backward step with finite loss and gradients reaching trainable RQ-VAE parameters.

findings.detail: The designated tree has no trainer, data loader, SID exporter, or distributed launcher/configuration. Therefore the real entry point, train/validation/test frozen-transform data path, SID validity/index alignment, and distributed launch are absent and cannot be verified. A proposal-only tree cannot satisfy the requested integration check.
findings.reproduction: Enumerate files under the designated tree: only PROPOSAL.json is present. No trainer command or export artifact can be run from this tree.
findings.correction: Populate the tree with the integrated implementation and its normal entry point, preserving item IDs through SID export and applying the same train-fitted mu/A for every split; verify the standard distributed launcher against it.
